openings.claim: Pencil each envelope’s assigned pattern and exact quantities; mark quantities only after insertion. This extends tags and samples into filling checks and exterior assignment guidance.
openings.discriminator: Quantity confusion predicts fewer omissions with shared trays plus checks; interference predicts local loose materials outperform those checks.
openings.probe: Alternate equal matched-mixture batches: incumbent, shared trays with checks, local materials without checks. Count contents independently; record preparation, filling, checking, omissions and crossing reaches. Verify table fit and stop within 90 minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Specifications must be available accurately. Writing overhead and full-run effectiveness remain unknown; the omission-free twelve-kit batch had an unknown mixture.

openings.claim: Draw numbered cells on each envelope, grouped by material and specified dimensions; place actual units beside cells before immediate insertion. Empty cells expose incomplete picks; exterior names identify assignments.
openings.discriminator: Holding local access constant, added detection supports counting guidance; equal accuracy with faster unmarked kits supports proximity alone.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes, alternate six marked and six unmarked kits with matched mixtures and identical local access. Include drawing and immediate contents checks; record incomplete picks, finished omissions and elapsed time. Stop if layout fails.
openings.uncertainty: Writable area, copying accuracy and opened-packet footprint are unconfirmed. Marking maintenance and insertion checks remain human work; unchanged detection, missing items despite completed cells, or projected time above 90 minutes defeats adoption.

decision: Keep both as untested probes. All evidence is synthetic. Preserve specified quantities and dimensions, exactly two volunteers, the 180-by-75-centimetre table, existing envelopes and supplies, and no purchases. Adoption requires 60 complete assigned kits within 90 minutes including preparation/checking, with at most one distribution correction. Picking versus filling remains unresolved; later supply depletion and unopened-stock access may prevent small-batch transfer.
